newsitem.title: GERMANY: Debis 96 sales rise 15 pct to 13.6 bln DM.
newsitem.headline: Debis 96 sales rise 15 pct to 13.6 bln DM.

text.p: Financial and information services provider Daimler-Benz InterServices AG (Debis) said on Wednesday its 1996 sales rose 15 percent to 13.6 billion marks.
The company, a unit of car maker Daimler-Benz AG, also said it had "good" operating results in 1996 and expected 1997 sales of well over 14 billion marks.
Debis said its financial service revenue grew 14 percent to 8.7 billion marks, while insurance revenue rose eight percent to 103 million marks.
In its Debitel mobile phone service, sales soared 73 percent to 1.6 billion marks. Debis Systemhaus, an information service unit, saw sales climb 15 percent to 2.2 billion marks.
Trading revenue was up 11 percent to 445 million marks and property management revenue tripled to 207 million marks.
Debis closed the year with 11,367 employees, up from 10,196 a year ago.
